titel: Second factor: new or lost phone
kurz: When you sign in, the online page asks for a six-digit number from your authenticator app in addition to the password. If the phone is new or gone, you set up the second factor again from the PC.
brauchst: Access to the PC the AMW runs on – the second factor can only be reset from there.
User name and password of the online page.
An authenticator app on the new phone.

schritte.text: Run the command `amw web zweitfaktor-neu`. It deletes the previous secret in the online storage; the old app no longer shows valid numbers afterwards.
Open the online page, enter user name and password and leave the field for the number empty.
The page shows a new QR code. Scan it with the authenticator app and confirm the first number.
Remove the AMW entry on the old phone or in the old app.

fehler: The operating mode does not allow the online storage; choose “Cloud” under Settings › Operating mode.
The phone’s clock is wrong (the number is only valid for about 30 seconds) or the number has been used before; wait for the next one.
After 5 failed attempts from one address, sign-in is locked for up to 15 minutes. Wait; the limits are under Settings › Online site.
danach: Resetting only works on the PC. Someone who only knows the password cannot get around the second factor.
The password stays as it was.
fragen: I lost my phone – do I have to act right away?
Yes: reset (step 1) so that the app on the lost phone no longer delivers valid numbers, then set it up again.
Yes, if both scan the same QR code during setup. Later, a second device can only be added by resetting and scanning again with both.
